So I'm here at George Floyd Square, which is the intersection in South Minneapolis where George Floyd was killed by Derek Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 我现在就在乔治·弗洛伊德广场，这是南明尼阿波利斯的十字路口，乔治·弗洛伊德就是在这里被德里克·肖万杀害的。

sentences.en: And when the verdict was read, you know, people put their arms in the air.
sentences.zh: 当判决结果宣读时，你知道，人们纷纷举起双臂。

sentences.en: They celebrated, they yelled, many people cried.
sentences.zh: 他们欢呼，他们呐喊，许多人流下了眼泪。

sentences.en: It was just kind of a scene of humanity.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个充满人性的场景。

sentences.en: People are chanting George Floyd's name now.
sentences.zh: 人们现在正在高呼乔治·弗洛伊德的名字。

sentences.en: It's just really a feeling of, in one way, jubilation out here.
sentences.zh: 这儿确实给人一种欢欣鼓舞的感觉。

sentences.en: And in another sense, I also sense a lot of relief from people.
sentences.zh: 但在另一方面，我也感觉到人们如释重负。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Today, Derek Chauvin is found guilty of murder in the death of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 今天，德里克·肖万被判谋杀乔治·弗洛伊德罪名成立。

sentences.en: My colleague, John Eligo, covered the trial, the verdict, and the reaction in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 我的同事约翰·埃利戈报道了这次审判、判决结果以及明尼阿波利斯的反应。

sentences.en: John, describe what happened on Tuesday at this courthouse in downtown Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 约翰，请描述一下周二在明尼阿波利斯市中心这家法院发生的事情。
描述一下当时的现场情况。

sentences.en: So, Tuesday morning, it's the first full day that the jury is deliberating.
sentences.zh: 周二上午，是陪审团进行审议的第一个完整日。

sentences.en: And they're sequestered in an undisclosed location, so no one knows where they are but the court officials.
sentences.zh: 他们被隔离在一个未公开的地点，除了法院官员，没人知道他们在哪里。

sentences.en: And so we are just left to wait, you know, to get some news.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能等待，你知道，等待消息。

sentences.en: Is there, you know, how's the deliberations going?
Like, we're just kind of waiting, right?
And then, out of nowhere, at 2.28 p.m., I get an email in my inbox, and it says, quote,
sentences.zh: 然后，毫无预兆地，下午2点28分，我的收件箱收到了一封邮件，上面写着，引用如下：

sentences.en: And at that moment, it's like, all systems go, right?
sentences.zh: 那一刻，就像是所有系统都准备就绪了，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, we've been through three weeks of testimony, three weeks of jury selection before that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们经历了三周的证词陈述，在此之前还有三周的陪审团遴选。

sentences.en: And now we've gotten to 10 hours of deliberations, and here we were, like, about 11 months after George Floyd died.
sentences.zh: 现在审议已经进行了10个小时，此时距离乔治·弗洛伊德去世大约11个月了。

sentences.en: We're about to hear the fate of Derek Chauvin.
sentences.zh: 我们即将听到德里克·肖万的命运。

sentences.en: And at 4 p.m., the judge walks in.
And it's just pin-drop quiet in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 法庭里安静得连根针掉在地上都能听见。

sentences.en: Members of the jury, I understand you have a verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团成员们，我了解到你们已经有了裁决。

sentences.en: And then he starts to read.
State of Minnesota, county of Hennepin.
And as he's reading, the cameras are in close on Derek Chauvin's eyes.
sentences.zh: 当他宣读时，摄像机近距离拍摄着德里克·肖万的眼睛。

sentences.en: He's wearing a mask, so all you can really see are his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他戴着口罩，所以你真正能看到的只有他的眼睛。

sentences.en: And you can see them just shifting, like, from left to right.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到它们在不停地左右转动。

sentences.en: It's like he was shifting them from looking up at the judge to looking over at the jury.
sentences.zh: 就像他在抬头看法官和转头看陪审团之间来回切换。

sentences.en: You know, looking up at the judge, looking over at the jury.
sentences.zh: 你知道，抬头看法官，转头看陪审团。

sentences.en: He wasn't moving his head at all, just his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他的头一点也没动，只有眼睛在动。

sentences.en: And that same shifting kept on happening as the judge read each verdict.
sentences.zh: 当法官宣读每一项裁决时，这种转动一直在持续。

sentences.en: We, the jury, in the above entitled matter, as to count one,
sentences.zh: 我们，陪审团，在上述案件中，关于第一项指控，

sentences.zh: 在实施重罪过程中犯下的非蓄意二级谋杀罪，裁定被告有罪。

sentences.en: We, the jury, in the above entitled matter, as to count two, third-degree murder perpetrating an eminently dangerous act, find the defendant guilty.
sentences.zh: 我们，陪审团，在上述案件中，关于第二项指控，即实施极其危险行为导致的三级谋杀罪，裁定被告有罪。

sentences.en: This verdict agreed to this 20th day.

sentences.zh: 同样的抬头，第三项裁决。

sentences.en: This verdict agreed to this 20th day of April 20th.
And at that moment, it's just, there's really no expression on Chauvin's face that you could see.

sentences.zh: 只有他的眼睛还在转动。

sentences.zh: 陪审团成员们，我现在要逐一询问你们，这些是否是你们真实且正确的裁决。

sentences.en: And at that point, the judge does a roll call for each juror, asking each juror if that was indeed their verdict.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，法官对每位陪审员进行了点名，询问每位陪审员这是否确实是他们的裁决。

sentences.zh: 9号陪审员，这些是您真实且正确的裁决吗？

sentences.zh: 你们一人如是说，你们全体如是说。

sentences.zh: 然后我们又看向德里克·肖万。

sentences.en: Exchanges a brief word with his lawyer, and then he's taken away to the back and the door is closed.

sentences.en: John, for those who may not know exactly what the three charges that Chauvin was found guilty of mean, can you translate them?
sentences.zh: 约翰，对于那些可能不完全了解肖万被判有罪的三项指控意味着什么的人，你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: Second-degree murder, third-degree murder, and second-degree manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 二级谋杀罪、三级谋杀罪和二级过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: Yeah, essentially, the second-degree murder, which is the most serious charge he faced, that was alleging that in the commission of a felony crime,
sentences.zh: 是的，本质上，二级谋杀罪是他面临的最严重的指控，指控称在实施重罪的过程中，

sentences.en: Derek Chauvin caused the death of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 德里克·肖万导致了乔治·弗洛伊德的死亡。

sentences.en: And in this case, the felony crime was assault.
sentences.zh: 在本案中，重罪是袭击罪。

sentences.en: And whether or not he intended to, that assault resulted in George Floyd's death.
sentences.zh: 无论他是否有意，那次袭击导致了乔治·弗洛伊德的死亡。

sentences.en: Now, the second count that he was facing was third-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 现在，他面临的第二项指控是三级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: And basically what that says is, again, it was not that he intended to kill George Floyd, but that he acted with reckless disregard for human life.
sentences.zh: 基本上它的意思是，同样，并不是说他有意杀死乔治·弗洛伊德，而是他表现出了对人命的漠视。

sentences.en: And in those actions of reckless disregard, he caused the death of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 在这种漠视的行为中，他导致了乔治·弗洛伊德的死亡。

sentences.en: And the final charge was manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 最后一项指控是过失杀人罪。

sentences.en: That was the least serious charge.
What that charge says is that Derek Chauvin created an unreasonable risk and consciously took a chance of causing death or great bodily harm to George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 这项指控的意思是，德里克·肖万制造了不合理的风险，并有意识地冒着导致乔治·弗洛伊德死亡或严重身体伤害的风险。

sentences.en: And the way it's written in Minnesota law, they call it culpable negligence.
sentences.zh: 按照明尼苏达州的法律写法，他们称之为疏忽大意。

sentences.en: And again, that is not that he had to intend to kill George Floyd, but that he took actions that an ordinary and reasonably prudent person would see
sentences.zh: 同样，这并不是说他必须有意杀死乔治·弗洛伊德，而是他采取了普通且理智的人会认为

sentences.en: could cause death or injury to George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 可能导致乔治·弗洛伊德死亡或受伤的行为。

sentences.en: So now that we have a verdict, I want to talk about the arguments during the trial that, in retrospect, appear to have led this jury

sentences.en: to a unanimous declaration of guilt on all three counts.
sentences.zh: 在所有三项指控上达成了一致的定罪声明。

sentences.en: You know, Michael, I wouldn't say that there's any one single witness who landed the hardeSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，迈克尔，我不会说有哪一位证人最有说服力。

sentences.en: I think the strength of the prosecution's case is that it really had this cumulative effect where
sentences.zh: 我认为控方案件的优势在于它确实产生了这种累积效应，

sentences.en: Including the police chief To continue to apply that level of force And said, this is not what we do as policing That in no way, shape, or form is anything that is by policy

sentences.en: It is not part of our training And it is certainly not part of our ethics or our values

肺科医生、心脏病专家、法医。

剥夺了乔治·弗洛伊德的氧气。

sentences.en: I mean, I can't help but remember

Well, because people on the influence of drugs may not be hearing what you're trying to ask them to do They may not understand

There are certain drugs that are present in his system It was the drugs in his system
